product.olivetti-m30008.summary: 20 MHz 386SX desktop with OPTi 82C283, separate 82C206 and integrated OAK OTI-067 video.
product.olivetti-m30008.history: The BA319/BA324/BA325 M300-08 is a later compact platform, distinct from IF378 and TOPCAT. Its manual documents a 10 MHz AT bus and 2/4/8/10/14/16 MB memory; 6 and 12 MB are impossible.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.verifi: POST, Setup, calendar year rollover, 1.44 MB floppy and MS-DOS 3.30a boot validated. With an IDE disk set to AUTO, the BIOS reads the disk geometry and boots from it.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.limita: Bootable partial emulation. The 82C283 is modelled and the AT bus is fixed at 10 MHz; the 82C206 is represented by the common AT core and RTC timing remains an approximation. Setup has no hotkey: it only appears on a cold boot when POST detects a configuration error, so opening it requires changing the machine configuration or deleting its NVR.
product.olivetti-m30008.creation.storage: No hard disk: one 1.44 MB floppy drive
40 MB IDE disk (805/4/26); the BIOS detects it
100 MB IDE disk (776/8/33); the BIOS detects it
product.olivetti-m30008.creation.model: M300-08 with a 20 MHz 386SX, 2 MB, integrated OTI-067 and one 1.44 MB floppy drive
product.olivetti-m30008.creation.note: The BIOS reads the IDE disk geometry at startup, so there is no need to choose a type in Setup.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.commer: The service guide lists the BA324 (2 MB) and BA325 (4 MB) boards; the BA325 was discontinued and the memory difference was then fitted at system level.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.cpu: 20 MHz Intel 386SX on the BA324 board, with an i387SX socket. OPTi 82C283 memory and bus controller, and 82C206 for RTC, DMA, interrupts and timer. Four 16-bit ISA slots on the IN133 bus board.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.memory: 2 MB soldered in bank 0 and three banks of two sockets for 1 M × 9 (2 MB) or 4 M × 9 (8 MB) SIMMs: 2 to 16 MB. 6 and 12 MB are not possible, and with 16 MB the 2 MB soldered are lost.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.video: Integrated OAK OTI-067 VGA, with 256 KB expandable to 512 KB with the VGA-MEM kit.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.storag: Floppy controller and serial and parallel ports in the 87310; buffered IDE interface on the board. Documented disks are 40, 85 and 120 MB. The BIOS reads the IDE disk geometry at startup.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.firmwa: BIOS 1.08 (12/04/92), 64 KB, is preserved, with a separate 32 KB EVC video ROM. The M300-08 and M300-15 images differ in only five bytes. The service guide stops at 1.07.
product.olivetti-m30008.technical.servic: Olivetti Personal Computer - Pocket Service Guide, chapter 28: M300-08.
